why: The project's proposition_7_1_12 (instance Finite (X.Isotropy x)) and B ({g | s g = x ∧ t g = x}.Finite) say the same thing: X.Isotropy x is the structure of morphisms with the two equations, and val is a bijection onto B's set (Isotropy.ext for injectivity). A_to_B uses A's instance; B_to_A derives proposition_7_1_12 from B. The second conjunct of A, MPolyfold.finite_isotropy_of_isLocalScDiffeo, is an abstract statement for arbitrary maps s, t : Y → X of M-polyfolds (t a local sc-diffeomorphism, t proper on s⁻¹(cl V)); it is not about an ep-groupoid and cannot follow from B, so it was re-proved outright (compact discrete fibre). Universes at 0.
